Terrain and roof surfaces: LINZ LiDAR (2025), at true vertical scale.
Building outlines: LINZ aerial imagery (2021). Facades and verandas are fictional.
Outer buildings use coarser survey-derived heights. Park lawns and sports fields follow mapped OpenStreetMap boundaries; planting is approximate.
Regional buildings use survey-derived approximate heights and simpler roof forms. Harbour tides, beach surfaces, bridges and wharf decks are visual approximations of mapped geography. Rail tracks follow mapped routes; platforms and ambient train service are simplified. Weather is a fictional simulation.
Wainuiomata Tunnel: mapped disused route; the explorable interior is fictional.
Aerial imagery: © NZ Aerial Surveys / Hutt City Council (2025 urban); AAM NZ Ltd / Greater Wellington Regional Council (2021 rural; GWRC regional basemap 2021 for Upper Hutt ground). CC BY 4.0.
Roof photo source · cropped and mapped to survey geometry.
Upper Hutt: LINZ footprints with LiDAR-derived roof heights where available; roof shapes inferred from footprints and height samples. National 8m contour DEM sampled to a 25m terrain grid.
Wellington City: mapped OSM streets and shoreline, LINZ building footprints; OSM building heights where tagged, otherwise estimated from footprint size. New western terrain uses the national 8m DEM on a 25m grid.
Cell-site positions: RSM / MBIE public licence locations, 31 October 2026. Structures and heights are illustrative; this is not a historical mobile-network map.
Regional terrain gaps: LINZ 2013–14 LiDAR / national 8m DEM.
